name: Yolodex
description:
Yolodex answers the questions advertising teams actually argue about: which ads are working, why they are working, and what to make next.

Connect it to Claude and ask about your advertising the way you would ask a colleague who has watched every ad you have ever run.

Which ads are actually winning? Every ad is scored against what a typical ad achieves at the same frequency and funnel stage, so a cold prospecting ad and a retargeting ad can finally be compared fairly. You get a ranked answer with the reason attached — whether it was the creative, the offer, or the delivery.

Why did that one work? The hook, format, execution style, proof type, pain point and desire are read out of every ad's video or image. So you can ask which hook style is carrying the account this month, or whether statics are outperforming video, and get an answer about the creative rather than about the spend.

What are competitors doing? Track any brand and search their advertising by idea rather than keyword — "who is running founder-story ads about sleep?" — and see how long each ad has been sustained, which is usually the honest signal that it works.

What do customers actually say? Search your reviews, plus Reddit, Instagram and TikTok, for the language your buyers use — then tie that language back to the angles your ads are already running.

What should we make next? Turn any of the above into a creative brief with the evidence cited inline, ready to hand to whoever builds the ad.

Yolodex works for anyone running Meta ads — in-house marketing teams, agencies managing client accounts, and founders running their own campaigns. You will need a Yolodex account with a connected Meta ad account. Access is scoped to the organizations you belong to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yolodex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yolodex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://personas.yolodex.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yolodex MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yolodex lists 68 MCP tools, including add_angle, add_brand, add_brand_assets_from_urls, add_persona, add_value_proposition, assign_angle_evidence, connect_ad_account, create_organization, create_strategy, discover_instagram, discover_reddit, and discover_tiktok.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yolodex?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Yolodex in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Yolodex requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yolodex is developed by Yolodex. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
